create_enchantment_industry.ponder.tag.e: Items and Components related to experience
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.exper: Introduction to Experience Handling
This is a tank of Liquid Experience, the primary form of Experience used in Enchantment Industry
Converting the Experience you carry to liquid form requires two components
Liquid Hatch for accessing liquids directly from items
Experience Hatch for accessing experience directly from the player
But as part of Create, automation is a must, right?
Things you might want to know
There are a few more things you need to know before you're ready to start using Enchantment Industry
Block of Experience is no longer purely decorative and storage block. You'll need it later
Block of Experience is required to make both the Enchantment Template and the Block of Super Experience
This is Block of Super Experience, used to make Super Enchanting Templates
Blaze Enchanter
Blaze Forger
Seething Blaze Forgers and Enchanters are in Super Enchanting mode
Super Enchanting allows you to surpass traditional enchanting limits, including exceeding the vanilla level cap and merging conflicting enchantments
Prepare materials for Super Enchanting
First, obtain a Block of Super Experience, which will be used to make the Super Enchanting Template. This requires Block of Experience
Next, place a Lightning Rod
Lightning Strike!
The vast majority of lightning strikes only have a certain probability of transforming Block of Experience, and only lightning strikes caused by Super Enchanting are guaranteed to transform
Super Enchanting Templates are crafted from Block of Super Experience. In Super Enchanting mode, Blaze Forgers and Enchanters must use Super Enchanting Templates
As Beacon base block

create_enchantment_industry.ponder.exper: Introduction to Experience Hatch
The Experience Hatch is simple to use. Right click it to store Experience...
...Shift-Right-Click Hatch to extract stored Experience
There are a filter slot and a scroll panel on Hatch. You can configure how much Experience is retrieved or deposited per interaction on the panel
The filter slot is used to deal with experience fluids of other mods
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.mecha: Right-click an Item Drain with Mechanical Grindstone...
This is a Grindstone Drain. Place another Mechanical Grindstone on top to use it
Experience in item form can be crushed into liquid form by Mechanical Grindstone
Mechanical Grindstone not only has all the features of a grindstone...
...but it also has the features of Sand Paper
Items can be manually applied to Mechanical Grindstone
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.disen: All received items will have their enchantments removed and the removed enchantments will be converted to liquid experience for storage.

create_enchantment_industry.ponder.encha: Blaze Enchanter can enchant your items.
However, it cannot work on books...
... nor can it add incompatible enchantments to your items.
Blaze Enchanter can upgrade an existing enchantment to a higher level if feasible
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.hyper: Hyper experience can make the Blaze Enchanter into seething state, and the level of the enchantment produced in this state will be one level higher than the set enchantment.
Enchantment with level cap of 1 level cannot be upgraded to level 2 in hyper-enchant.
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.trans: Right-click the Blaze Burner with an Enchanting Guide in hand when sneaking to transform it to a Blaze Enchanter.
To make Blaze Enchanter work, Enchanting Guide must be configured first. Right-clicking Blaze Enchanter or right-clicking Enchanting Guide in hands can open configuration panel.
To retrieve the enchanting guide, right-click the Blaze Enchanter with wrench when sneaking.
You can replace the Enchanting Guide by holding it directly in your hand and right-clicking on the Blaze Enchanter.
Liquid Experience is required to duplicate enchanted books.
If the enchantment on the enchantment book you are copying has a level that exceeds its maximum level, then you will need Hyper Experience.
Ink is required to duplicate written books.
Name Tag and Train Schedule can also be copied.
If you set the name tag as the print target, you can use the printer to name the item.
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.blaze: This is a Blaze Forger, which functions like an Anvil
Provide it Liquid Experience to activate it
Blaze Forger can merge enchantments of the same item like an anvil, but with no Repair Cost
Blaze Forger can also merge Enchanting Templates
Most importantly, Blaze Forger is able to apply Enchanting Templates to items!
Also, Blaze Forger is able to strip enchantment from equipment, book or Enchanting Template to a blank Enchanting Template!
While in Super Enchanting mode, Blaze Forger can surpass the vanilla enchantment level cap while merging enchantments. Conflicting enchantments can also be merged together
Blaze Forger in Super Enchanting mode exclusively processes and applies Super Enchanting Templates
Make sure to place a Lightning Rod nearby
Blaze Forger can be automated with Mechanical Arm
Mechanical Arm can insert items for forging and extract forged results
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.print: Before use, set the item to print via the filter slot...
It can copy enchanted books, written books, name tags, schedules, clipboards, banner patterns and more. Use JEI to look up printing recipes

Experience Lantern absorbs experience from nearby players and experience orbs. It glows according to the amount of experience stored internally
Experience Lantern also works on Contraptions
